title: Binary-Input RS Encoder
text: 从二进制向量数据创建 Reed-Solomon 码，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Output data type} 指定模块的输出类型 Same as；{Codeword length N (symbols)} 指定码字长度、{Message length K (symbols)} 指定消息字长度、{Shortened message length S (symbols)} 指定缩短的消息字长度、{Generator polynomial} 指定生成多项式 rsgenpoly、{Primitive polynomial} 指定本原多项式、{Puncture vector} 指定删余向量，按实例取值。

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Reed-Solomon 码字 binary column vector

params.name: Shortened message length S (symbols)
params.values: 缩短的消息字长度 3 (default) | integer

params.name: Generator polynomial
params.values: 生成多项式 rsgenpoly(7, 3, [], [], ’double’) (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector | binary Galois row vector

params.name: Primitive polynomial
params.values: 本原多项式 ’X^3 + X + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector

params.name: Puncture vector
params.values: 删余向量 [ones(2,1); zeros(2,1)] (default) | binary column vector

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 模块的输出类型 Same as input (default) | boolean | double
